thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: us-west-2 cont-batch: KV page-faults and evictions spike detected > sustained for 3m; 5xxs climbing to 2.8%; invoking contbatch-paging playbook :warning:

maya (oncall): Acknowledged. pinging runtime + sre. which release changed batch params recently?

liam (eng-runtime): We shipped a performance tuning 4h ago that bumped `continuous_batch.max_num_seqs` to 96 for higher throughput on multi-turn flows. It passed smoke but not long-horizon sims.

olivia (sre): Host-level swap activity on gpu-17 observed, OOM-kernel evict events. `kvcache.evictions_per_min` ~3600 on some nodes. Looks like kvcache working set overflow -> eviction storm.

raja (eng-ml): Explanation: raising max_num_seqs increases active KV per batch. If `max_batch_tokens` is large simultaneously, per-batch KV grows superlinearly and can exceed memory fragmentation thresholds => paging.

maya (oncall): Immediate mitigation proposal: apply dynamic config limiting to reduce blast radius, cap kvcache active pages, and run a small canary. Plan: 1) dynconf set contbatch.max_num_seqs=24 2) dynconf set contbatch.max_batch_tokens=1024 3) kvcache.max_active_pages=1500. Canary pool-3 (3% traffic) first.

liam (eng-runtime): I can push dynconf. preparing commands:
```
# apply conservative dynamic limits
dynconf set prod-us-west-2 contbatch.max_num_seqs 24 --reason "incident mitigation 2611112222"
dynconf set prod-us-west-2 contbatch.max_batch_tokens 1024 --reason "incident mitigation 2611112222"
dynconf set prod-us-west-2 kvcache.max_active_pages 1500 --reason "incident mitigation 2611112222"
```

deploy-bot: dynconf change submitted by liam, change-id=dc-92011, targeting pool-3. CI quickchecks OK.

cicd-bot: Canary live. Auto-monitoring enabled (latency/error/evictions).

liam (eng-runtime): Canary metrics after 45s: canary nodes `kvcache.evictions_per_min` down from ~3.6k -> ~80. p99 gen latency reduced by ~700ms. No regression in throughput for canary.

olivia (sre): Good. initiating linear rollout across remainder of us-west-2 with 10% steps. Watching for swap churn to subside.

tess (support): FYI: we already have inbound tickets from two dedicated customers in us-west-2 reporting "responses timing out". Notified account teams and sent short customer-facing note.

maya (oncall): Keep customers updated: "Mitigation in progress, we expect improved latency within 20 minutes; we'll follow up with root cause and next steps."

liam (eng-runtime): Rollout complete. Cluster-level metrics: evictions back to normal baseline ~150/min, 5xx dropped to 0.4%.

olivia (sre): Confirming no node-level OOMs after changes. Marking incident as mitigated. Will keep monitoring for 1h before fully closing.

raja (eng-ml): Action items: run a battery of synthetic multi-turn dialogs in staging with new traffic shapes, and publish recommended safe defaults for `max_num_seqs` and `max_batch_tokens` per model family. Also add a per-batch KV payload metric so we can alarm on large KV batches early.

liam (eng-runtime): Engineering follow-ups: 1) add dynamic guardrail that automatically reduces `max_num_seqs` if `kvcache.evictions_per_min > 1000` for >60s, 2) backfill longer regression test in CI that simulates high seq-count workloads, 3) update rollout checklist to include kvcache stress test when changing cont-batch params. I'll open PRs.

product-anna: Any customer SLA exposure?

tess (support): Two customers impacted with increased latency and intermittent failures during 18m window. Support has filed severity cases; no billing credits yet — will coordinate if SLA threshold met.

maya (oncall): Incident timeline for postmortem: detection -> 02m, mitigation plan decided -> 05m, canary up -> 08m, rollback-limits applied -> 10m, full rollout -> 25m. Total customer-facing impact ~18m.

olivia (sre): Postmortem owner assigned. Proposed summary: cont-batch misconfiguration (aggressive max_num_seqs) combined with large max_batch_tokens triggered KV cache working-set blowup and eviction storm. Mitigations: conservative dynamic limits + kvcache cap + staged rollout. Next steps: metric guardrails, auto-throttle, test infra updates, safe defaults documentation.

liam (eng-runtime): PRs and dashboards will be linked in postmortem. draft PR link: https://git.internal/repo/contbatch/PR-4927

maya (oncall): Handing follow-up to @olivia. I'll finish incident log and customer notes. Thanks all.

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated (2611112222) by olivia. Duration: 00:25:44. Add postmortem when ready.
summary: KV cache eviction/paging storm in us-west-2 driven by aggressive continuous-batching config change (max_num_seqs); dynconf rollback-limits and kvcache cap applied via canary then full rollout; evictions and 5xx restored; customers notified; follow-ups: guardrails, auto-throttle, testing improvements.
